practice_questions.question_text: A lending database includes private member addresses and loan details. Evaluate giving an external courier unrestricted access compared with a read-only view containing only the delivery fields it needs.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Retains access-benefit/privacy evaluation but explicitly assesses relational security and views, rather than generic insurance ethics.
practice_questions.solution: Unrestricted access may make ad hoc queries easy, but reveals unrelated private information and may permit damaging edits. A restricted read-only view supplies the address and dispatch details required for delivery while hiding other records and preventing updates through that interface. View permissions and maintenance are needed; the limited view is preferable for the courier’s defined task.

marking_points.criterion: Relevant unrestricted-access convenience.

View supplies only required delivery fields.
Read-only/restricted permissions reduce harm, with maintenance limitation.
